Hi James —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through FinTechX's goals around latency-sensitive document ingestion and reranking. Quick recap from our side:
- Current pain: slow embeddings pipeline and inconsistent rerank quality at 100ms SLO
- Desired outcome: predictable inference latency under 150ms p50 for production traffic and a path to reduce per-token cost via batching and KV caching
- Next step we agreed: 45-min technical demo + SRE/infra deep-dive with Rafael to validate architecture and sizing

Rafael, can you join the demo so we can cover model variants and routing?

James — are you available for any of the following slots (all PDT)? I want to lock one in and send a calendar invite:
1) Tue May 11, 10:00–10:45 AM
2) Tue May 11, 3:00–3:45 PM
3) Wed May 12, 9:00–9:45 AM

I’m sending a one-pager and a proposed mutual action plan (attached) so you have something to share with your procurement/SRE team. If those times don't work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll tighten confirmation.

Thanks —
